messages:
Sam L (eng-ml): heads-up — bringing up quantized-mistral-8k-int8 on the toolcall bench. seeing intermittent JSON parse failures from funcall responses when using the int8 execution path. failure ~8% vs ~0.9% fp16 so far.
Priya R (research): can you paste one of the raw outputs that failed the schema check?
Sam L (eng-ml): here's an anonymized one: `{"action": "search", "params": { "query": "coffee shops", }` -> trailing comma, and sometimes single quotes like `{\'id\': 123}`. also some responses are truncated mid-json.
Carol J (evals): hmm. trailing commas / single quotes suggests decoding noise. could be quantization-induced tokenization shift, or the generation temperature/top_k tuning. what's the decode config?
Sam L (eng-ml): default decode: temperature 0.2, top_p 0.95, no repetition penalty. kv-cache enabled. we run beam 1 (greedy-ish).
Evan T (infra): also relevant: our parser currently treats any non-strict JSON as parse-fail and triggers a single retry with the same decode params. the "rescue" heuristics (quote-fix, trailing-comma-strip) only run on the second retry — maybe too late.
Priya R (research): that explains some of the delta. two quick suspects: (A) quantization changes logits that increase probability of punctuation tokens in certain contexts; (B) cache alignment issues when using kv-cache with int8 kernels. did you try with kv-cache off?
Sam L (eng-ml): ran a small ablation: kv-cache off reduces failures to ~3.5% int8. so it's strongly correlated.
Carol J (evals): ok actionable plan: we should (1) capture failing tokens/logits around the JSON boundary, (2) compare token IDs pre/post-quant between fp16 and int8, (3) try decode configs (temp 0, temp 0.1, top_p 0.9) and (4) move some rescue heuristics earlier.
Sam L (eng-ml): proposed experiment script: `./scripts/onboard/quant_toolcall_ablation.sh --model mistral-8k-int8 --n 500 --capture-logits --kv-cache {on,off} --decodes "0,0.1,0.2"`
Evan T (infra): I'll provision a dedicated test-pool for this so it doesn't affect production dedicated nodes. queue: quantized-serving-int8 v2 -> test pool, scheduled in ~45m. ci-bot: can you enqueue that?
ci-bot: deploy queued: quantized-serving-int8 v2 -> test-pool (region: us-west) — estimated start 2026-03-20T13:15:00Z
Carol J (evals): for eval scoring: we'll check schema compliance (strict JSON parse), then run a "rescue" pass: JSONLint + heuristics (strip trailing commas, replace single quotes, balance braces). If heuristics succeed, mark as "rescue_applied" and compute field-level edit distance vs expected schema.
Priya R (research): also add a metric for hallucinated extra keys / unexpected types — we had a few cases where the model emitted an extra `debug` field that broke downstream tool routing.
Sam L (eng-ml): noted — adding `unexpected_keys_ratio` to the harness. I'll also collect raw partial outputs where the model truncated mid-json so we can trace whether EOS token probs spiked.
Evan T (infra): FYI — quant kernels on this hardware had a recent micro-optimization that rearranged attention kernel scheduling. I'll put a diagnostic flag to run the old kernel path for a short run to compare.
Carol J (evals): experiment matrix summary (Carol): 500 samples x 2 kv-cache states x 3 temps x 2 kernel-paths = 6000 evals. We'll record: parse_fail, rescue_success, rescue_type, unexpected_keys_ratio, field_edit_distance, latency.
Sam L (eng-ml): timeline: run in test-pool tonight, initial metrics in ~6hrs, follow-up postmortem if >2% residual parse-fail after rescue.
Priya R (research): small suggestion — try an optimistic rescue on first attempt for models we know are noisy (quantized variants). run rescue but mark trace as "optimistic_rescue_v1" so consumers can decide.
Evan T (infra): agree. keep rescue opt-in per model. we'll add a feature flag to the serving runtime: `enable_optimistic_json_rescue` (default off).
Sam L (eng-ml): I'll add telemetry events: `parse_fail`, `rescue_attempt`, `rescue_success`, `rescue_type`, and include model_tag + quant_level.
ci-bot: test-run started: quantized-serving-int8 v2 on test-pool (job id: qint8-20260320-01)
Carol J (evals): once results are in I'll share a short CSV and a notebook with case examples. we should also include a small human review of ~50 rescued examples to make sure rescue doesn't silently change semantics.
Priya R (research): agreed — human in loop for the first rollout. also cross-check tokenizers between fp16 and int8 builds to ensure vocab mapping identical.
Sam L (eng-ml): will post results here. ping me if you want access to the test pool logs. /cc @Evan T
Evan T (infra): will grant access to the job logs after allocation.
Sam L (eng-ml): thanks all — will update with numbers. :thumbsup:
